_comment: cutoffs=[1,5]. Citation-lookup matches on document_uuid / cluster_id /
normalized citation string — outcomes are effectively binary at rank 1
for most rows (either the API resolved to the expected document, or it
didn't). We report hit@5 as a supporting cushion for the small fraction
of rows where the expected doc falls to rank 2-5 due to citation-string
ambiguity. Larger K values (10, 25) add noise without signal here.
headline_cutoff=1 — the headline metric is 'did the correct document
rank first for a citation the user typed?'.
api_request_limit is forwarded by the runner into providerConfig.limit
when the provider config doesn't set one. TrustFoundry's public API
caps limit at 25; CourtListener citation-lookup returns all candidate
